integrity.claims: An exact structural theorem with self-contained guard-exchange proof and finite-case reproducibility checker. The known scalar minimum is attributed to earlier literature.

scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Mycielskians of K_{a,b} with a,b>=4, and only the minimum layer of secure dominating sets; no claim for smaller shores or full polynomials. Historical priority provisional.
title: Exact minimum secure dominating sets in Mycielskians of complete bipartite graphs
